verdict.rationale: Skyvern has a dedicated CAPTCHA docs page stating that its vision model detects and automatically solves reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile, FunCaptcha/ArkoseLabs, MTCaptcha and image CAPTCHAs, and the products page repeats that stance. Separately, it documents taking control through a VNC stream, run failure categories with recordings, and terminal-status webhooks, so failures surface instead of passing silently. missing for 10: documented behavior when CAPTCHA solving fails (an explicit CAPTCHA-specific human fallback or failure category), independent or hands-on corroboration of solve reliability.
